scope: Main 337–339 before Faster, faster; exercises 7.2.1.2–55–76; answers 711–715 through 76

exceptions.detail: Complete cycle/path censuses and equivalence-class counts in 58,60–61,63–64,66–67 and the full large-pattern checks in Figures 42–44 were not rerun. Small displayed transitions and the structural arguments were checked; Monte Carlo estimates are retained as estimates.

The 358-cycle maximum, exhaustive obstruction and long 720-step construction in 70 were not re-enumerated or expanded in full. The general external existence results cited in 64,66,68–69 and the known 2020 Sawada–Williams replacement for 71 are accepted as cited results, not independently reproved.

The cited Erdos–Trotter prime-family obstruction in answer 75 was retained without a new proof; the torus and knight-tour gcd formulas were checked by the stated coset method. Every one of the 64 transitions of Figure 45 was not individually transcribed.
